Gate: Product evidence review and business-plan draft
Summary: Blocks progress when an existing app or product is analyzed without observable evidence.
PassCriteria: Artifacts list inspected source evidence and label observed product behavior separately from assumptions.
FailCriteria: Artifacts infer product value, customer behavior, or market claims without source evidence or explicit assumption labels.
EscalationRule: Return to product evidence review and inspect the missing app, workflow, or evidence source.
